_comment: BAND-SPLIT-2. See band1_lower_meadows/vegetation.json for why this file exists. `order` equals the index this entry held in the pre-split file.

clearings._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation (clearings[8], named explicitly in docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2 as `vegetation.clearings[8]`): (23,158) -> (400,1800), same offset as the quarry floor.
clearings._why: SD16: the Old Quarry's worked floor -- foundations, the conduit head and five rootstone deposits stand on it, and a copse growing through the middle of a working face would undo the read before the drained ground ever got a chance. The `deadfall` anchor above sets `cleared_by_clearings: false` so this does not throw its authored stand away -- see its own note

BAND2-63, prompt 61's camp-siting brief: a 'relatively flat/buildable... memorable clearing'. The `ranger_camp` prop cluster (props.json order 2001) already reads as a place someone lived, on the `ranger_camp_spur` loop -- off the critical path, short of the Warrens' own aggro, past both the quarry and the ridge population, which is exactly what prompt 61 asks a field camp to be. It had no clearing entry, so the scatter's own scenery had exactly as much claim to this ground as the authored props (GATE_D_LANE_CONTRACT.md sec4's known fingerprint defect means this specific clearing does not take effect until the coordinator's re-bake). Radius 15 covers the authored prop footprint plus real open ground around it -- this file authors the clearing only; the recovery itself stays the player's own creature-bed build, not a pre-built free hotel (prompt 61's own rule).

BAND2-63-WARRENS: the Burrow Warrens' new mouth (burrow_warrens.json `_comment_resiting`). The cave stands in a rock knoll of its own here, and the driven run found the doorway itself blocked by a `CommonTree_3` growing where the entrance is -- the scatter had no idea the cave had moved, because nothing told it. Radius 30 covers the whole footprint plus the apron and the last stretch of the approach, so the outcrop reads as rock breaking out of the ground rather than a boulder pile in a wood, and so nothing is standing in the doorway. This clearing does NOT take effect until the coordinator's single re-bake -- GATE_D_LANE_CONTRACT.md sec4's inherited fingerprint defect, the same one the `ranger_camp` clearing above is waiting on.

trees._why: VP4 station 06-stone-root-entry (310,1660)->(400,1800): the before frame had a signpost but an otherwise bare gap between the player and a thin horizon tree line on entering Band 2. A tree line flanking the path's left side, ~65m ahead.

VP4 station 07-band2-mid (20,2130)->(-150,2210): the worst 'empty grass to sky' case in the whole pass -- bald ground from the player's feet to the horizon on both sides. A tree line flanking the left side of the path ~70m ahead, opposite the rock cluster below.

rocks._why: VP4 station 06-stone-root-entry: a rock cluster on the right side of the path, matching this band's own 'Stone & Root' identity as well as filling the sightline. `min_slope_deg` overridden to 0 for the same reason as band 1's bend cluster -- this shoulder reads as gentle meadow, not the layer's usual 6-degree floor.

VP4 station 07-band2-mid: a second mid-ground anchor on the right side of the path, ~110m ahead, so the sightline reads compression (near trees) -> open -> a second landmark rather than one clump and then bare ground again.

bushes._why: VP4 station 06: edge planting on the new tree line.
